notes.title: About the future of the game
notes.content:
[b]Greetings.[/b]

I will use this post to present myself, as well as give a bit of context for this game and its situation, regarding maintenance and updates.

I am Alex, I did a few GameJams in the past and worked as a software engineer. I was able to take a bit over a year to focus on personal projects, and spent nearly all of it making this game. Models, textures, the music ... unless said otherwise in the credits, it's made by me, using opensource software and tools.

I will have to return to full time employment, therefore my time investment in the game will be greatly reduced. I will do my best to push bug fixes and patches for bugs that are reported via the support, and I am not abandoning this project.

I hope you get some fun out of Hepatomancy, or at least tell me how it should have been better.

Thank you for reading, have a great day!
